sources.entry: pytesseract - A wrapper for the Tesseract OCR engine.

summary.one_liner: Tesseract is an open-source OCR engine (libtesseract) with a command-line program that extracts text from images, supporting over 100 languages and multiple output formats.
summary.what_it_does: The repository contains the libtesseract OCR engine and the tesseract command-line program. Tesseract 4 and later add an LSTM neural-net recognizer focused on text lines, and the legacy character-pattern engine remains available via --oem 0 with compatible traineddata files. It reads various image formats such as PNG, JPEG and TIFF, and supports UTF-8 and more than 100 languages out of the box. Output can be plain text, hOCR, PDF, invisible-text-only PDF, TSV, ALTO and PAGE. Developers can call the C or C++ API, and the README points to a wrapper section for other language bindings. The project can also be trained to recognize additional languages.
use_cases: run OCR from the command line
read text from photos or PNG/JPEG/TIFF files
add OCR to a C or C++ application
train OCR for a new language
how_to_run: Install Tesseract from a pre-built binary package, or build it from source with a supported compiler
tesseract imagename outputbase [-l lang] [--oem ocrenginemode] [--psm pagesegmode] [configfiles...]
tesseract --help or man tesseract for option details
notable: LSTM neural-net OCR engine in Tesseract 4+, with legacy engine still available
Recognizes more than 100 languages out of the box
Multiple output formats including hOCR, PDF, ALTO and PAGE
caveats: The project includes no GUI application; the README points to third-party tools
Better results often require improving the input image quality
Legacy engine mode needs traineddata files that support it
